note: Frozen before any of these seeds or the real data was generated or read. Do not edit; a change needs frozen/v2.json.

selector.primary: pooled tune:gate over every test window of every seed, bar-level selector vs SBS, alpha 0.05
selector.secondary: number of seeds where the bar-level selector passes tune:gate vs SBS at alpha 0.05

detector.calibrated-on: seed 7, six tapes (P4 grid cut {0.3,0.5,0.7} x k {1,2,4,8,12})

seed-rule: n = 0, 1, ...: v = int(sha256('aura-fx-frozen-v1:' + str(n)).hexdigest(), 16) % 90000 + 1000; keep v unless used before {7, 11, 23, 31, 47, 99} or already kept; first 10

real.source: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-hist.zip, column USD (USD per EUR), one value per TARGET business day
real.rule: ascending by date, drop N/A, keep dates <= 2026-11-13, take the last 1920 rows, cut into 6 consecutive tapes of 320 bars (8 windows of 40); same train/test windows as the seeds. No regime labels, so only the selector is checked on it.
